dedupe_keys.name: dataset for sea level changes and strains of both infragravity waves and tsunamis

description: Takashi Tonegawa at JAMSTEC publishes processed sea-level and submarine-fibre-strain observations from the Muroto cable off southwestern Japan. The February 2026 Zenodo deposit is free under CC BY 4.0 and is explicitly cited by the describing paper as its figure-reproduction data. The study compares ambient infragravity waves from January–September 2023 with the October 2023 Torishima and July 2025 Kamchatka tsunamis, using nearby DONET pressure records. Numerous DAT files contain figure and station-specific products. These observations can calibrate cable-based tsunami-detection and sea-level inference in coastal infrastructure resilience simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this processed collection. Relations depend on frequency and cable coupling; some segments do not respond to pressure, and low-frequency strain may reflect temperature effects. Exact DAT column layouts, units and missing-value conventions remain unknown. A file named README proved to be compressed binary, so it was not unpacked or used as documentation. No numerical observations were inspected or retained.
